signed_distance_definition: (current fingertip midpoint - current object center) dot fixed initial axis; positive on initial-hand side, negative after crossing the perpendicular zero line. Pixels; not signed Euclidean distance.
coordinate_origin: Top-left of cropped image; add crop left/top for source coordinates.

distance_measurements.hand_object_distance: Euclidean distance from landmarks 4/8 midpoint to object centre (legacy)
distance_measurements.index_mcp_object_distance: Euclidean distance from index MCP landmark 5 (display node 2) to object centre
distance_measurements.wrist_object_distance: Euclidean distance from wrist landmark 0 (display node 1) to object centre
distance_measurements.hand_object_signed_distance: Legacy signed midpoint projection retained separately
